streams.name: Fire Conjuration
streams.description: Call flame, cinder servants or concentrated heat into presence.
streams.consequence: Heat and fuel are displaced from another source.

streams.name: Fire Abjuration
streams.description: Burn away curses, intrusions, cold or unwanted material.
streams.consequence: Rejected force returns as stored heat or ash.

streams.name: Fire Alteration
streams.description: Change ignition, combustion, temperature or material temper.
streams.consequence: Subjects overheat, become hungry for fuel or continue accelerating.

streams.name: Fire Restoration
streams.description: Rekindle dormant heat, retemper metal or reverse thermal damage.
streams.consequence: The chosen former state may restore old flaws as well as strength.

streams.name: Fire Evocation
streams.description: Release flame, light, heat or explosive force.
streams.consequence: Recoil cools the source, exhausts the caster or ignites the surroundings.

streams.name: Fire Enchantment
streams.description: Bind fire into weapons, furnaces, courage or persistent radiance.
streams.consequence: The effect develops continuing fuel and containment needs.

streams.name: Fire Divination
streams.description: Read smoke, burns, heat gradients and moments of illumination.
streams.consequence: Observation brightens the connection and may reveal the diviner.

streams.name: Fire Veiling
streams.description: Hide heat and light through smoke, ember suppression or black flame.
streams.consequence: The concealment creates blindness, cold pockets or missing evidence.

streams.name: Water Conjuration
streams.description: Call water, mist, currents or fluid spirits.
streams.consequence: Atmosphere, aquifers or distant watersheds become drier.

streams.name: Water Abjuration
streams.description: Exclude water, poison, pressure or unwanted fluid movement.
streams.consequence: Rejected volume and pressure accumulate elsewhere.

streams.name: Water Alteration
streams.description: Change phase, viscosity, salinity, flow or dissolving power.
streams.consequence: The fluid remembers its old course and may revert unpredictably.

streams.name: Water Restoration
streams.description: Rehydrate, cleanse, return a river to its course or restore fluid balance.
streams.consequence: Earlier impurities, floods or biological contents may also return.

streams.name: Water Evocation
streams.description: Release jets, waves, pressure bursts and sudden currents.
streams.consequence: The source suffers recoil, erosion or abrupt pressure loss.

streams.name: Water Enchantment
streams.description: Bind healing pools, protective currents and self-filling vessels.
streams.consequence: The enchantment continually demands water or redistributes it nearby.

streams.name: Water Divination
streams.description: Scry through reflection, current, taste and carried memory.
streams.consequence: The observed place gains a reflective route back.

streams.name: Water Veiling
streams.description: Conceal with mist, washed scent, blurred reflection or fluid identity.
streams.consequence: Names, tracks and friendly recognition may wash away too.

streams.name: Air Conjuration
streams.description: Call wind, breath, voices or atmospheric spirits.
streams.consequence: Pressure and breathable air are displaced from another region.

streams.name: Air Abjuration
streams.description: Exclude sound, gas, missiles, scent or hostile weather.
streams.consequence: Rejected motion accumulates around the boundary.

streams.name: Air Alteration
streams.description: Change pressure, buoyancy, voice, drag or the path of motion.
streams.consequence: Movement continues after control ends or produces turbulent drift.

streams.name: Air Restoration
streams.description: Return breath, restore a voice or settle damaged weather patterns.
streams.consequence: The restored pattern may reintroduce old winds and carried contaminants.

streams.name: Air Evocation
streams.description: Release gusts, thunder, pressure blades and kinetic force.
streams.consequence: Recoil displaces the caster or disturbs a much larger air mass.

streams.name: Air Enchantment
streams.description: Bind flight, favourable winds, resonant speech or circulating air.
streams.consequence: The effect needs open routes and resists confinement.

streams.name: Air Divination
streams.description: Read messages, echoes, weather, scent and distant vibration.
streams.consequence: Information travels both ways along the established current.

streams.name: Air Veiling
streams.description: Suppress sound, scent, wake and atmospheric disturbance.
streams.consequence: The veiled region may lose warning signals and breathable circulation.

streams.name: Earth Conjuration
streams.description: Call stone, mineral, ore or simple earthen constructs.
streams.consequence: Mass is displaced, leaving hollows, subsidence or depleted seams.

streams.name: Earth Abjuration
streams.description: Raise walls, seals, foundations and immovable boundaries.
streams.consequence: Stress accumulates in the barrier and adjacent ground.

streams.name: Earth Alteration
streams.description: Shape stone, metal, density, hardness and terrain.
streams.consequence: Material memory pulls the subject toward its former structure.

streams.name: Earth Restoration
streams.description: Repair buildings, rejoin fractures and return land to stable form.
streams.consequence: Old stresses and buried defects may be restored with the shape.

streams.name: Earth Evocation
streams.description: Release shards, seismic force, sudden weight and moving ground.
streams.consequence: Momentum remains in the earth as aftershocks and structural fatigue.

streams.name: Earth Enchantment
streams.description: Bind endurance, fortification, load-bearing and material memory.
streams.consequence: The anchor becomes rigid, heavy and resistant to later alteration.

streams.name: Earth Divination
streams.description: Read ore, tremors, footprints, ruins and mineral memory.
streams.consequence: The reader becomes perceptible to deep or buried things.

streams.name: Earth Veiling
streams.description: Conceal through burial, stone likeness and broken material traces.
streams.consequence: Hidden subjects become difficult to move, retrieve or distinguish from terrain.

streams.name: Bloom Conjuration
streams.description: Call plants, beasts, tissue, seed and living servants.
streams.consequence: Nutrients and reproductive potential are displaced from nearby life.

streams.name: Bloom Abjuration
streams.description: Reject disease, parasites, foreign tissue and invasive life.
streams.consequence: The excluded life seeks another host or ecological niche.

streams.name: Bloom Alteration
streams.description: Mutate bodies, instincts, growth and adaptation.
streams.consequence: Change continues through inheritance, appetite or uncontrolled variation.

streams.name: Bloom Restoration
streams.description: Heal, regenerate and return organisms toward viable form.
streams.consequence: The chosen healthy state is ambiguous and may overgrow.

streams.name: Bloom Evocation
streams.description: Release thorns, spores, growth bursts and animal force.
streams.consequence: Rapid life consumes nutrients and oxygen abruptly.

streams.name: Bloom Enchantment
streams.description: Bind fertility, adaptation, symbiosis and living protection.
streams.consequence: The effect develops needs and may evolve beyond its original purpose.

streams.name: Bloom Divination
streams.description: Read health, lineage, instinct, ecology and reproductive potential.
streams.consequence: Observed life becomes subtly responsive to the observer's expectations.

streams.name: Bloom Veiling
streams.description: Hide through camouflage, mimicry, dormancy and ecological belonging.
streams.consequence: Identity blurs with the host environment or species.

streams.name: Grave Conjuration
streams.description: Call ancestors, remains, death echoes and funerary servants.
streams.consequence: The dead gain presence, claims and opportunities to remain.

streams.name: Grave Abjuration
streams.description: Conclude hauntings, dismiss the dead and end lingering processes.
streams.consequence: Unresolved memory accumulates at the boundary of dismissal.

streams.name: Grave Alteration
streams.description: Change age, decay, bone, residue and the pace of ending.
streams.consequence: The subject inherits qualities of previous decay states.

streams.name: Grave Restoration
streams.description: Recover memory, reconstruct remains or return a dead identity.
streams.consequence: It is unclear which remembered version of the person returns.

streams.name: Grave Evocation
streams.description: Release withering, fear, decay and the force of endings.
streams.consequence: The caster and landscape inherit exhaustion and residue.

streams.name: Grave Enchantment
streams.description: Bind curses, ancestral guardians and persistent funerary duties.
streams.consequence: The enchantment develops claims based on inheritance and remembrance.

streams.name: Grave Divination
streams.description: Read the past, last impressions, remains and ancestral memory.
streams.consequence: The dead become aware that they are remembered.

streams.name: Grave Veiling
streams.description: Conceal death, erase funerary signs or quiet remembered presence.
streams.consequence: Mourning, inheritance and historical knowledge may disappear too.

streams.name: Star Conjuration
streams.description: Call remote presence, astral images, named beings and celestial patterns.
streams.consequence: A route of correspondence remains open in both directions.

streams.name: Star Abjuration
streams.description: Return things to their proper place or sever them by true name.
streams.consequence: The rejected target strains against the imposed cosmic order.

streams.name: Star Alteration
streams.description: Change distance, relation, probability, name and destiny.
streams.consequence: New correspondences entangle unrelated lives and events.

streams.name: Star Restoration
streams.description: Return a name, orbit, fate or soul to its proper pattern.
streams.consequence: The definition of proper may privilege an older destiny over present choice.

streams.name: Star Evocation
streams.description: Release starlight, radiant pattern and sudden alignment.
streams.consequence: The event becomes visible to distant observers and powers.

streams.name: Star Enchantment
streams.description: Bind wards, communions, oaths and shared destinies.
streams.consequence: Participants remain linked and inherit one another's consequences.

streams.name: Star Divination
streams.description: Read fate, distance, names, souls and celestial relation.
streams.consequence: Observation forms a reciprocal sympathetic link.

streams.name: Star Veiling
streams.description: Misdirect names, routes, fate and celestial attention.
streams.consequence: The veiled subject may lose beneficial connections and recognition.

streams.name: Void Conjuration
streams.description: Call an absence, aperture, null anomaly or being from beyond relation.
streams.consequence: Reality is displaced and the absence may begin consuming context.

streams.name: Void Abjuration
streams.description: Erase, banish, isolate or sever a sustaining connection.
streams.consequence: The removed relationship leaves a gap that nearby patterns may fall into.

streams.name: Void Alteration
streams.description: Hollow matter, silence properties and remove selected relations.
streams.consequence: The subject becomes difficult to define, repair or remember.

streams.name: Void Restoration
streams.description: Return a place or object to an empty, untouched or unconnected state.
streams.consequence: Everything added since that state risks being treated as foreign.

streams.name: Void Evocation
streams.description: Release null pulses, silence and momentary cancellation.
streams.consequence: Nearby magic, memory and causality suffer collateral gaps.

streams.name: Void Enchantment
streams.description: Bind null zones, perfect seals and persistent absence.
streams.consequence: The anchor and surroundings gradually lose context and connection.

streams.name: Void Divination
streams.description: Read absences, blind spots, broken links and things omitted from reality.
streams.consequence: The act of noticing may give the absent thing a route back.

streams.name: Void Veiling
streams.description: Create profound concealment, forgetting and informational severance.
streams.consequence: The caster may also lose access to the hidden subject.
